phrases: The future is built one contribution at a time.
Every dollar invested today is freedom down the road.
Small steps now, big leaps later.
Wealth isn't luck — it's a habit.

common.comingSoonDesc: This module will be built on top of the local data in the next steps.
common.baseCurrencyHint: The currency you manage everything in: new entries are created in it and totals are shown in it. Each item can still keep its own currency. From the top bar you can view everything converted to another currency — a temporary preview that resets to your main currency on reload.

dashboard.emptyDesc: Add your net worth and budget — your numbers show up here, always encrypted on your device.

patrimonio.noAssetsDesc: Add your investments, properties and accounts to see your net worth.
patrimonio.noLiabilitiesDesc: Loans, financing and cards go here.
patrimonio.name: Name
patrimonio.tickerHint: Fill in Ticker, Qty and Avg. price — the value auto-updates from the daily quote and shows your return.
patrimonio.emptyAssets: Add your first asset by choosing a class.
patrimonio.errAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

orcamento.recurringHint: Mark fixed entries (rent, salary, subscriptions) with ↻ — they flow into the next months on their own.
orcamento.historyHint: Tap a bar to open that month

historico.autoHint: The current month is captured automatically from your net worth and keeps itself updated. Edit any row to take it over.

investimentos.hint: Set a target % per class; rebalancing shows how much to buy or sell to get there.

fire.title: Financial independence
fire.subtitle: ≈ {{mult}}× your annual expenses
fire.empty: Add your spending in Budget (or enter it below) to see how much wealth would sustain your lifestyle.
fire.hint: Estimate in today's money (real return of the base scenario). The 4% rule is a starting point, not investment advice.

proventos.title: Dividends
proventos.hint: Log dividends, interest-on-equity and REIT income received (source, month YYYY-MM and amount). Yield is the last 12 months' income over total invested.

crossborder.fxHint: You hold wealth in more than one currency. When exchange rates move, your net worth (in your main currency) moves with them. See your exposure and sensitivity.
crossborder.fxEmpty: Add assets to see your FX exposure.
crossborder.sensitivityHint: If foreign currencies appreciate or depreciate {{pct}}% against your main currency.
crossborder.colHint: What it would cost to keep your current spending standard in another country (approximate index, Brazil = 100).
crossborder.colDisclaimer: Static, approximate index — order of magnitude, not exact prices. Doesn't account for FX or rent specifically.
crossborder.fiscalHint: Reminders of key obligations for living between countries. Informational — confirm deadlines and your case with an accountant.
crossborder.fiscalDisclaimer: Informational only, not tax or legal advice. Rules and deadlines change and depend on your situation.

crs.title: CRS — information exchange
crs.desc: Banks report non-residents' accounts to tax authorities, which exchange data between countries (Common Reporting Standard). Keep what you declare here and abroad consistent.

brExit.title: Brazil tax exit
brExit.desc: When you become a tax resident abroad: file the Definitive Departure Communication and Declaration in Brazil so you're no longer taxed as a resident.

irpf.title: IRPF (Brazil)
irpf.desc: While a Brazilian tax resident, the annual income tax return is normally due end of April.

quadroRw.title: Quadro RW (Italy)
quadroRw.desc: Italian residents declare foreign assets and accounts (monitoraggio fiscale) — including investments and property held abroad.

dichiarazione.title: Dichiarazione dei redditi (Italy)
dichiarazione.desc: Italian income tax return (Modello Redditi / 730). Deadlines usually fall between September and November, depending on the form.

forfettario.title: Regime Forfettario (Italy)
forfettario.desc: Simplified flat-tax regime for the self-employed with a revenue cap — worth assessing if you provide services in Italy.

data.title: Data
data.sampleDesc: Fill the app with fictional data to explore.
data.resetDesc: Erase all data and start blank.
data.resetConfirm: Erase ALL data and start from scratch? This cannot be undone.
data.exportJsonDesc: Download a file with ALL your data to keep or move to another device.
data.importJsonDesc: Load a JSON backup. Fully replaces your current data.
data.importConfirm: Importing REPLACES all current data with the backup. Continue?
data.importError: Invalid file. Pick a .json backup exported by this app.
data.exportCsvDesc: Flat spreadsheet (assets, expenses, income…) to open in Excel/Sheets.

footer.tagline: Multicurrency wealth & budget — local-first and end-to-end encrypted.
